Md. Durul Islam

full_judgment: 8. The learned Deputy Attorney General appearing for the State submits that the first Information Report disclosed incriminating material on the involvement of the accused appellant in hundi business which is a matter of evidence at the time of the trial. As such order of taking cognizance for a offence under Section 25-B of Special Powers Act on presumption of fact as to the commission of offence deserves no interference.
